name: Mahila Samriddhi Yojana (MSY)
purpose: Micro/small income-generating activities for SC women

name: Micro Credit Finance (MCF)
purpose: Small/petty trade and sundry income-generating activities (e.g. betel leaf shop, bakery, candle making, cycle repair, goatery, beauty parlour, vegetable vending, tea shop)
source: socialjustice.gov.in Annexure-I(a); cross-checked against nsfdc.nic.in scheme page

name: Suvidha Loan Scheme
purpose: Self-employment loans for small business activities per beneficiary needs (replaced Term Loan for projects up to Rs. 10 lakh, effective 01.10.2023)
source: NSFDC official scheme page + socialjustice.gov.in Annexure-I(a)
notes: Replaced Term Loan (for projects up to Rs.10 lakh) effective 01.10.2023. Absorbed Green Business Scheme, Stand-Up India (NSFDC component), Swachhta Udyami Yojana, and Mahila Adhikarita Yojana.

name: Utkarsh Loan Scheme
purpose: Self-employment loans for larger business/manufacturing projects (replaced Term Loan for projects above Rs. 10 lakh, effective 01.10.2023)
source: socialjustice.gov.in Annexure-I(a); cross-checked against NSFDC Term Loan replacement notice
notes: Replaced Term Loan (for projects above Rs.10 lakh, up to Rs.50 lakh) effective 01.10.2023.

name: Aajeevika Microfinance Yojana (AMY)
purpose: Prompt, need-based micro finance for small/micro business activities via NBFC-MFIs
notes: Higher beneficiary interest rate (15%) reflects NBFC-MFI cost of funds vs. bank/SCA-routed schemes.

name: Udyam Nidhi Yojana (UNY)
purpose: Small business financing routed through Co-operative Societies / Co-operative Banks

name: Term Loan (LEGACY — DISCONTINUED)
notes: Discontinued effective 01.10.2023. Replaced by Suvidha Loan Scheme (projects up to Rs.10 lakh) and Utkarsh Loan Scheme (projects above Rs.10 lakh up to Rs.50 lakh). Kept in dataset only to prevent stale references — DO NOT surface in active matching.
